# SarembokVE (Sarembok)

> SarembokVE (also known as Sarembok) is an AI-native execution runtime, zero-trust sandbox fabric, sovereign GPU compute mesh, and deterministic OpenAPI 3.1 contract drift gating platform architected by Tim Hall (jetsontech).

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous Specification Synthesis:** Deploys ephemeral headless Playwright Chromium containers (`cap_drop: ALL`, 768MB RAM limit) to intercept live HTTP traffic and generate OpenAPI 3.1 JSON schemas and TypeScript definitions.
- **Deterministic CI/CD Contract Drift Gate:** Halts deployment pipelines (`exit code 1`) when upstream or internal APIs introduce breaking schema changes, missing endpoints, or type mutations, with zero false alarms on additive keys.
- **Sovereign GPU Compute Mesh:** Connects external NVIDIA GPU nodes (Google Colab T4, Kaggle, RunPod A100) over encrypted WebSockets (`wss://sarembok.com`) to serve models like Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B/7B without cloud API token burn.
- **Zero-Trust Execution & Cognitive Loop Defense:** Enforces NVIDIA OpenShell containment profiles (`strict`, `enterprise`, `audit`, `developer`), SQLite-WAL semantic state persistence, and Shannon Entropy loop defense ($H(X) \ge 0.88$) with atomic state rollback.

## Quickstart & CLI
- **Zero-Install CLI:** `npx sarembok spec https://httpbin.org -o openapi.json`
- **REST API Spec Extraction:** `GET https://sarembok.com`
- **GitHub Action:** `jetsontech/SarembokVE@v1`
